headline: Trump 🍊👑 Slaps 60 Nations 💥 with Forced Labor Tariffs 🧾🔨
text: Donald 🍊👨‍💼 just DROPPED the MIC 🎤 on 60 trading partners 🌍📦 with a fresh wave of 10-12.5% tariffs 💰🚧 that replaced the old global duty that expired Friday 🗓️💨! The White House claims it's about forced labour 🏭😡 but trade expert Caroline Freund said it's just Trump looking for a legal loophole 🕳️🧾 to keep the cash flowing 💵🌊! US Trade Rep Jamieson Greer spilled the tea ☕ saying the levies will 'correct human rights abuse' 🤡 but everyone knows it's really about the trade deficit 📉🍔 and US manufacturing 🏭💪! The new tariffs hit 99.4% of American imports 📦💸 covering the UK 🇬🇧, China 🇨🇳, EU 🇪🇺 and everyone else in the naughty corner 😈! UK whisky 🍺 got a special exemption after King Charles and Queen Camilla's state visit 🤴👸 but everything else is getting the Trump tax 🔨💸! China said 'no forced labour here' 🙅‍♂️ but human rights groups say otherwise in Xinjiang 🕌😬! Japan and Australia called the tariffs 'unjustified' 😤 while Brazil got hit with the full 12.5% rate 💥! The UK lost its edge to the EU 🇪🇺 which has a sweet 10% all-inclusive deal 🍯 while Brits face extra duties on top 😩! BCC boss William Bain said businesses are sweating 😰 about how to get the same EU treatment 🤝! Trump keeps using tariffs like a golden hammer 🔨 to fix every problem from Mexico 🇲🇽 to Canada 🍁 and now the whole world 🌍! The Supreme Court struck down his first 'Liberation Day' tariffs in February ⚖️ but he found a workaround faster than you can say 'legal loophole' 🕳️💨! Now the White House is eyeing 16 more countries for manufacturing overcapacity investigations 🔍🏭 so buckle up for round two 💥🚀!
